lines.en: It sure looked good on the mannequin.
I sure wish I had more time to talk to my clients, though.
Isn't it what you said to a bunch of my clients
That I didn't have enough time for them?
Close your mouth, sweetie. You look like a trout.
I don't need to see Oscar's toes at work.
I mean, he looks like he just got off the boat.
Can't you just not look at his feet?
Oh, you're so educated, aren't you, Toby?
So trained to deal with a hysterical woman!
I don't want to look at his feet!
Well, I was in the seminary for a year
and dropped out 'cause I wanted to have sex with this girl, Cathy.
Took the first job I could find in HR.
I wouldn't say I have a passion for HR.
I'm sorry you're offended by my shoes,
but I'm not going to drive home to change.
I could loan you a pair of socks.
I was gonna wear them to volleyball for anything.
Can I talk to you privately for a second?
You might consider pulling it down a touch.
It's riding up a little high.
You know, Oscar's allowed to wear sandals,
but I'm not allowed to wear open to a shoes.
Thank you so much for saying that.
I can't believe that Toby thinks this is inappropriate.
You're dressed like this amorphous blob of khaki.
What you gotta understand is when you come to work,
Here are the new rules, okay?
Also, women are forbidden to wear pants.
Sit down or I'm writing you up.
You're running from the front way from the front.
